academic_years_dates_check.name: academic_years_dates_check
academic_years_dates_check.value:
extract(year from "academic_years"."start_date") = "academic_years"."start_year"
        and "academic_years"."end_date" > "academic_years"."start_date"
        and "academic_years"."end_date" < "academic_years"."start_date" + interval '1 year'

academic_years_lifecycle_check.name: academic_years_lifecycle_check
academic_years_lifecycle_check.value:
("academic_years"."status" = 'planned' and "academic_years"."activated_at" is null and "academic_years"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("academic_years"."status" = 'active' and "academic_years"."activated_at" is not null and "academic_years"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("academic_years"."status" = 'closed' and "academic_years"."activated_at" is not null and "academic_years"."closed_at" is not null)

generated.as: case "learner_kind" when 'student' then 'students' when 'prospect' then 'prospects' end
case "learner_kind" when 'student' then 'students' when 'prospect' then 'prospects' end

progression_decisions_review_check.name: progression_decisions_review_check
progression_decisions_review_check.value:
("progression_decisions"."status" = 'pending') = ("progression_decisions"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("progression_decisions"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) = ("progression_decisions"."reviewed_at" is null)
        and ("progression_decisions"."status" = 'rejected') = ("progression_decisions"."rejection_reason" is not null)
        and ("progression_decisions"."rejection_reason" is null
          or char_length(btrim("progression_decisions"."rejection_reason")) >= 1 and char_length("progression_decisions"."rejection_reason") <= 2000)
        and ("progression_decisions"."reviewed_at" is null or "progression_decisions"."reviewed_at" >= "progression_decisions"."decided_at")

course_certificates_cancellation_check.name: course_certificates_cancellation_check
course_certificates_cancellation_check.value:
("course_certificates"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("course_certificates"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null)
        and ("course_certificates"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null) = ("course_certificates"."cancelled_at" is null)
        and ("course_certificates"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null) = ("course_certificates"."cancellation_reason" is null)
        and ("course_certificates"."cancellation_reason" is null
          or (char_length(btrim("course_certificates"."cancellation_reason")) >= 1
            and char_length("course_certificates"."cancellation_reason") <= 500))
        and ("course_certificates"."cancelled_at" is null or "course_certificates"."cancelled_at" >= "course_certificates"."issued_at")

contracts_amendment_open_key.name: contracts_amendment_open_key
contracts_amendment_open_key.where: "contracts"."amends_contract_id" is not null and "contracts"."cancelled_at" is null and "contracts"."archived_at" is null

contracts_amounts_check.name: contracts_amounts_check
contracts_amounts_check.value: "contracts"."amount_cents" >= 0 and ("contracts"."gross_cents" is null or "contracts"."gross_cents" >= 0) and ("contracts"."net_cents" is null or "contracts"."net_cents" >= 0) and ("contracts"."scholarship_cents" is null or "contracts"."scholarship_cents" >= 0)

contracts_revision_check.name: contracts_revision_check
contracts_revision_check.value: "contracts"."revision" >= 1 and ("contracts"."amends_contract_id" is null) = ("contracts"."revision" = 1) and ("contracts"."amends_contract_id" is null) = ("contracts"."root_contract_id" = "contracts"."id")

contracts_terms_check.name: contracts_terms_check
contracts_terms_check.value: ("contracts"."tariff_id" is not null and "contracts"."tariff_version" is not null and "contracts"."gross_cents" is not null and "contracts"."net_cents" is not null and "contracts"."discounts" is not null and "contracts"."extras" is not null and "contracts"."terms_approved_by_user_id" is not null and "contracts"."payer" is not null) or ("contracts"."tariff_id" is null and "contracts"."tariff_version" is null and "contracts"."gross_cents" is null and "contracts"."net_cents" is null and "contracts"."discounts" is null and "contracts"."extras" is null and "contracts"."terms_approved_by_user_id" is null and "contracts"."payer" is null)

contracts_scholarship_check.name: contracts_scholarship_check
contracts_scholarship_check.value: ("contracts"."scholarship_program_id" is null) = ("contracts"."scholarship_cents" is null) and ("contracts"."scholarship_program_id" is null or "contracts"."tariff_id" is not null)

contracts_payment_term_check.name: contracts_payment_term_check
contracts_payment_term_check.value: "contracts"."payment_term" is null or "contracts"."tariff_id" is not null

contracts_signatory_check.name: contracts_signatory_check
contracts_signatory_check.value: ("contracts"."signatory_name" is not null and "contracts"."signatory_role" is not null and "contracts"."signatory_recorded_at" is not null and "contracts"."signatory_recorded_by_user_id" is not null) or ("contracts"."signatory_name" is null and "contracts"."signatory_role" is null and "contracts"."signatory_recorded_at" is null and "contracts"."signatory_recorded_by_user_id" is null)

contracts_approval_check.name: contracts_approval_check
contracts_approval_check.value: ("contracts"."approval_method" is not null and "contracts"."approved_at" is not null and "contracts"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "contracts"."approval_payer_name" is not null and "contracts"."approval_plan" is not null) or ("contracts"."approval_method" is null and "contracts"."approved_at" is null and "contracts"."approved_by_user_id" is null and "contracts"."approval_payer_name" is null and "contracts"."approval_plan" is null)

contracts_cancel_check.name: contracts_cancel_check
contracts_cancel_check.value: (("contracts"."cancelled_at" is not null and "contracts"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null and "contracts"."cancel_reason" is not null) or ("contracts"."cancelled_at" is null and "contracts"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null and "contracts"."cancel_reason" is null)) and ("contracts"."cancelled_at" is null or "contracts"."amends_contract_id" is not null)

contracts_approval_requires_signatory_ch.name: contracts_approval_requires_signatory_check
contracts_approval_requires_signatory_ch.value: "contracts"."approved_at" is null or "contracts"."signatory_recorded_at" is not null

contracts_proposed_plan_check.name: contracts_proposed_plan_check
contracts_proposed_plan_check.value: "contracts"."proposed_plan" is null or ("contracts"."amends_contract_id" is not null and "contracts"."approved_at" is null)

courses_e_ozel_program_key.name: courses_e_ozel_program_key
courses_e_ozel_program_key.where: "courses"."archived_at" is null and "courses"."e_ozel_program_key" is not null

courses_hours_check.name: courses_hours_check
courses_hours_check.value:
"courses"."total_hours" between 1 and 1200
        and "courses"."weekly_hours" between 1 and 40
        and "courses"."total_hours" >= "courses"."weekly_hours"

courses_lifecycle_check.name: courses_lifecycle_check
courses_lifecycle_check.value:
("courses"."status" = 'draft' and "courses"."activated_at" is null and "courses"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("courses"."status" = 'active' and "courses"."activated_at" is not null and "courses"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("courses"."status" = 'archived' and "courses"."archived_at" is not null)

courses_e_ozel_check.name: courses_e_ozel_check
courses_e_ozel_check.value:
("courses"."e_ozel_program_code" is null) = ("courses"."e_ozel_program_key" is null)
        and ("courses"."e_ozel_program_code" is null
          or char_length("courses"."e_ozel_program_code") between 1 and 50)
        and (("courses"."e_ozel_approval" = 'not_submitted'
            and "courses"."e_ozel_recorded_at" is null and "courses"."e_ozel_recorded_by_user_id" is null)
          or ("courses"."e_ozel_approval" <> 'not_submitted' and "courses"."e_ozel_program_code" is not null
            and "courses"."e_ozel_recorded_at" is not null and "courses"."e_ozel_recorded_by_user_id" is not null))

fee_tariffs_published_check.name: fee_tariffs_published_check
fee_tariffs_published_check.value: "fee_tariffs"."status" = 'draft' or ("fee_tariffs"."announced_date" is not null and "fee_tariffs"."published_by_user_id" is not null and "fee_tariffs"."published_at" is not null)

files_attached_check.name: files_attached_check
files_attached_check.value: ("files"."attached_type" is null) = ("files"."attached_id" is null) and ("files"."attached_id" is null) = ("files"."attached_at" is null)

finance_day_closings_cash_check.name: finance_day_closings_cash_check
finance_day_closings_cash_check.value: ("finance_day_closings"."counted_cash_cents" is null and "finance_day_closings"."opening_cash_cents" is null and "finance_day_closings"."expected_cash_cents" is null and "finance_day_closings"."cash_difference_cents" is null) or ("finance_day_closings"."counted_cash_cents" is not null and "finance_day_closings"."opening_cash_cents" is not null and "finance_day_closings"."expected_cash_cents" is not null and "finance_day_closings"."cash_difference_cents" = "finance_day_closings"."counted_cash_cents" - "finance_day_closings"."expected_cash_cents")

finance_day_closings_reopen_check.name: finance_day_closings_reopen_check
finance_day_closings_reopen_check.value: ("finance_day_closings"."reopened_at" is null and "finance_day_closings"."reopened_by_user_id" is null and "finance_day_closings"."reopen_reason" is null) or ("finance_day_closings"."reopened_at" is not null and "finance_day_closings"."reopened_by_user_id" is not null and "finance_day_closings"."reopen_reason" is not null)

lesson_packages_course_kind_check.name: lesson_packages_course_kind_check
lesson_packages_course_kind_check.value: "lesson_packages"."kind" <> 'course' or ("lesson_packages"."course_id" is not null and "lesson_packages"."lesson_hours" is null)

invoices_installment_key.name: invoices_installment_key
invoices_installment_key.where: "invoices"."archived_at" is null and "invoices"."root_contract_id" is not null

language_group_waitlist_student_key.name: language_group_waitlist_student_key
language_group_waitlist_student_key.where: "language_group_waitlist"."archived_at" is null and "language_group_waitlist"."student_id" is not null and "language_group_waitlist"."status" in ('waiting', 'offered')

language_group_waitlist_prospect_key.name: language_group_waitlist_prospect_key
language_group_waitlist_prospect_key.where: "language_group_waitlist"."archived_at" is null and "language_group_waitlist"."prospect_id" is not null and "language_group_waitlist"."status" in ('waiting', 'offered')

language_group_waitlist_offer_check.name: language_group_waitlist_offer_check
language_group_waitlist_offer_check.value:
(("language_group_waitlist"."offer_group_id" is null) = ("language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is null)
          and ("language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is null) = ("language_group_waitlist"."offer_expires_at" is null))
        and ("language_group_waitlist"."status" <> 'waiting' or "language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is null)
        and ("language_group_waitlist"."status" not in ('offered', 'accepted', 'expired') or "language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is not null)
        and ("language_group_waitlist"."offer_expires_at" is null or "language_group_waitlist"."offer_expires_at" > "language_group_waitlist"."offered_at")

language_groups_room_check.name: language_groups_room_check
language_groups_room_check.value:
("language_groups"."room" is null) = ("language_groups"."room_key" is null)
        and ("language_groups"."room" is null or char_length("language_groups"."room") between 1 and 60)
        and ("language_groups"."delivery" = 'in_person' or "language_groups"."room" is null)

language_groups_lifecycle_check.name: language_groups_lifecycle_check
language_groups_lifecycle_check.value:
("language_groups"."state" = 'planned' and "language_groups"."opened_at" is null and "language_groups"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("language_groups"."state" = 'open' and "language_groups"."opened_at" is not null and "language_groups"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("language_groups"."state" = 'cancelled' and "language_groups"."cancelled_at" is not null
          and "language_groups"."cancel_reason" is not null)

language_groups_cancel_check.name: language_groups_cancel_check
language_groups_cancel_check.value:
("language_groups"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length("language_groups"."cancel_reason") between 1 and 500)
        and ("language_groups"."merged_into_group_id" is null
          or ("language_groups"."state" = 'cancelled' and "language_groups"."merged_into_group_id" <> "language_groups"."id"))

payments_reference_key.name: payments_reference_key
payments_reference_key.where: "payments"."reference" is not null and "payments"."reversed_at" is null

payments_reversal_check.name: payments_reversal_check
payments_reversal_check.value: ("payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payments"."reversed_by_user_id" is null and "payments"."reversal_reason" is null) or ("payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payments"."reversed_by_user_id" is not null and "payments"."reversal_reason" is not null)

consents_withdrawal_check.name: consents_withdrawal_check
consents_withdrawal_check.value:
("consents"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("consents"."withdrawn_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("consents"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("consents"."withdrawal_reason" is null)

consents_dates_check.name: consents_dates_check
consents_dates_check.value:
("consents"."expires_at" is null or "consents"."expires_at" > "consents"."given_at")
        and ("consents"."withdrawn_at" is null or "consents"."withdrawn_at" >= "consents"."given_at")

privacy_notices_topic_check.name: privacy_notices_topic_check
privacy_notices_topic_check.value:
("privacy_notices"."kind" = 'notice' and "privacy_notices"."audience" is not null and "privacy_notices"."purpose" is null and not "privacy_notices"."requires_reconsent")
        or ("privacy_notices"."kind" = 'consent_text' and "privacy_notices"."purpose" is not null and "privacy_notices"."audience" is null)

rubric_versions_published_check.name: rubric_versions_published_check
rubric_versions_published_check.value:
("rubric_versions"."status" = 'draft') = ("rubric_versions"."published_at" is null)
        and ("rubric_versions"."status" <> 'published' or "rubric_versions"."archived_at" is null)
        and ("rubric_versions"."status" <> 'archived' or "rubric_versions"."archived_at" is not null)

score_appeals_decision_check.name: score_appeals_decision_check
score_appeals_decision_check.value:
("score_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("score_appeals"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("score_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("score_appeals"."decided_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("score_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("score_appeals"."decision_reason" is null)
        and ("score_appeals"."decided_at" is null or "score_appeals"."decided_at" >= "score_appeals"."filed_at")

submission_versions_draft_revision_check.name: submission_versions_draft_revision_check
submission_versions_draft_revision_check.value: "submission_versions"."draft_revision" is null or ("submission_versions"."draft_revision" >= 1 and "submission_versions"."body" is not null)

task_assignments_attempts_check.name: task_assignments_attempts_check
task_assignments_attempts_check.value:
("task_assignments"."kind" = 'practice') = ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null)
        and ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null) = ("task_assignments"."count_policy" is null)
        and ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null or "task_assignments"."max_attempts" between 1 and 3)
        and ("task_assignments"."count_policy" is null or "task_assignments"."count_policy" in ('first', 'highest'))
        and ("task_assignments"."count_policy" is distinct from 'highest' or "task_assignments"."max_attempts" > 1)
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'auto' or "task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null
          or ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" = 1 and "task_assignments"."count_policy" = 'first'))

task_assignments_deadline_check.name: task_assignments_deadline_check
task_assignments_deadline_check.value:
("task_assignments"."kind" = 'practice' or "task_assignments"."due_at" is not null)
        and "task_assignments"."late_acceptance_days" between 0 and 7

task_assignments_second_rating_check.name: task_assignments_second_rating_check
task_assignments_second_rating_check.value:
"task_assignments"."second_rating_percent" between 0 and 100
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'teacher' or "task_assignments"."second_rating_percent" = 0)
        and not ("task_assignments"."kind" = 'practice' and "task_assignments"."high_stakes")
        and (not "task_assignments"."high_stakes" or "task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'auto' or "task_assignments"."second_rating_percent" >= 10)

task_assignments_mode_check.name: task_assignments_mode_check
task_assignments_mode_check.value:
("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'teacher') = ("task_assignments"."submission_settings" is not null)
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'teacher' or "task_assignments"."rubric_version_id" is null)
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'auto'
          or ("task_assignments"."time_limit_minutes" is null and "task_assignments"."listening_plays" is null))

student_guardians_student_parent_key.name: student_guardians_student_parent_key
student_guardians_student_parent_key.where: "student_guardians"."parent_id" is not null and "student_guardians"."archived_at" is null

student_guardians_student_membership_key.name: student_guardians_student_membership_key
student_guardians_student_membership_key.where: "student_guardians"."membership_id" is not null and "student_guardians"."archived_at" is null

student_guardians_identity_check.name: student_guardians_identity_check
student_guardians_identity_check.value: "student_guardians"."parent_id" is not null or "student_guardians"."membership_id" is not null

student_guardians_restriction_check.name: student_guardians_restriction_check
student_guardians_restriction_check.value: not "student_guardians"."is_contact_restricted" or ("student_guardians"."custody" = 'none' and not "student_guardians"."is_payer" and not "student_guardians"."is_pickup_authorized")
